capabilities: define multi-column regions with column count, width, spacing and alignment settings
mark column breaks and end-of-column boundaries in a document
reflow an entire document into columns via frontmatter settings
insert regions, fix missing region IDs, and toggle mobile rendering via commands
define regions using Pandoc fenced divs syntax
extras: Live Preview support is limited: plugins that load content asynchronously (e.g. dataview) may not render inside columns, and embeds can flash on file interaction. Export to PDF is not supported, and a compatibility sheet lists plugins known to work inside columns. Deprecated code-block-based syntax remains but shows errors until updated.
problem: Obsidian renders notes as a single vertical column of content, so there is no built-in way to place text, tables or embeds side-by-side within a document.
summary: A Markdown layout plugin that renders user-defined multi-column regions and full-document column reflow in reading mode.
